verificationBoundary: Static comparison of canonical pinned PR patches with actual current Origin source only. rows.reason: The host watchdog knows a turn stalled but settles it with {ok:false,text} only. The active coordinator/runtime converts that result to provider_error, losing the host cause; room setup-finally has the same loss.

originEvidence.detail: Watchdog settles direct follow-up with no stalled flag.

Runtime.end likewise maps failure to provider_error.

hostTurnResult can still return cards after a failed result.

rows.scenario: A coordinator-owned direct turn, or a room turn stalled during setup before a provider result, reaches the host watchdog. The watchdog stops it for inactivity and resolves the pending host outcome with ok:false. RuntimeCoordinator.run/end receives no cause and persists outcome:'provider_error' instead of 'stalled'; if resumable cards remain, hostTurnResult can instead park a turn already declared stopped.
